source-precedence.conflict: mark CONFLICTED; retain both locators; block dependent claim

context-frontier.ask_gate: materially changes perfected state, constraints, current state, architecture, investigation, or plan

research-loop.branch: system > subsystem > capability > primitive > dependency > implementation > operation > lifecycle > failure > verification
research-loop.stop: open material questions have an evidenced path, compared candidates, or explicit unresolved evidence branches; further search is duplicative

terminal_rules.VERIFIED: all mandatory requirements trace to mechanism, task, evidence, owner, surface, and canonical destination; no critical/high finding
terminal_rules.BLOCKED: preserve evidence and continue independent branches; escalate only at the final safe-authority boundary
